Mediplus UK primarily designs, manufactures, and distributes
its own proprietary brand of specialized medical devices
rather than acting as a general distributor for third-party manufacturers. Their core product lines focus on anaesthesia, urology, urodynamics, and gynaecology.
Key Proprietary Brands and Product Ranges
Milex® & Popy®:
Their major proprietary ranges of silicone and specialized pessaries used for pelvic organ prolapse and urinary incontinence management.
S-Cath™:
A dedicated percutaneous bladder catheterisation system for urological care.
Mediplus Innovative Medical Devices
Capnomask™:
An anaesthesia face mask designed to monitor end-tidal CO2 while mitigating hypoxia risks.
SetGuard™ & Coventry Connectors:
Specialized protective and multi-port fluid/infusion connector accessories for intravenous and clinical delivery lines.
Mediplus Innovative Medical Devices
Mediplus TIVA:
Dedicated total intravenous anaesthesia giving sets and infusion systems.

Core Product Brands & Ranges
S-Cath™ System:
Percutaneous suprapubic catheter introduction device.
Coventry Connectors:
Multi-port, kink-resistant fluid line and infusion connectors.
TIVA Giving Sets:
Specialized intravenous delivery and infusion sets for total intravenous anesthesia.
Urology Disposables:
Exchange kits, Foley catheters, and cystometry monitoring lines.
